job.job_description:
Close AI Enablement Engineer

Job Description

Role Purpose:

Engage directly with end users through calls and working sessions to understand their day-to-day work, identify tasks with automation or AI-enablement potential, co-learn and experiment with AI-enabled approaches, and demonstrate successful usage and implementation in the user s actual workflow.
Ultimate objective is to coach and enable the end user to implement and continually use AI in a self-sustained and efficient manner.

Core Role Expectations:

Conduct structured conversations/calls with end users to understand processes, pain points, repetitive work and business outcomes.
Translate user observations into practical automation and AI-enablement opportunities.
Work collaboratively with users to co-learn AI capabilities and test them against real tasks and workflows.
Support proof-of-concept or pilot implementations and demonstrate measurable, repeatable usage.
Document use cases, learnings, implementation steps, outcomes and opportunities for scale.
Client Communication
Engage with end users through calls to understand their tasks, challenges, and process gaps.
Ask targeted questions to uncover repetitive or time-consuming activities.
Explain AI and automation opportunities in a simple, practical way.
Facilitate AI co-learning sessions and encourage users to experiment with AI.
Demonstrate AI-enabled solutions and showcase their practical business value.
Capture user feedback, document learnings and maintain clear stakeholder communication.
Work/Project specific
Understand existing business processes and identify tasks that can benefit from AI or automation.
Identify and qualify potential AI use cases based on user needs and business impact.
Work with users to test, refine and implement AI-enabled solutions.
Conduct POCs/pilots and validate solutions with actual end users.
Create and deliver demos showcasing successful AI adoption and usage.
Document use cases, solutions, learnings and implementation outcomes.
Collaborate with relevant teams to scale successful AI-enabled solutions
Job Specification
Excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written (English as a business language)
Interacts and improvises comfortably with US white collar professionals
Ability to Coach/Train/Handhold clients through building 2-way conversations
Good knowledge and hands on with AI platforms (Claude/ChatGPT, etc.)
Good with MS Excel/Word/PowerPoint
Strong communication skills for internal and cross-functional collaboration


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
